lower_quantized_model_to_native_backend: lower a quantized reference model with reference quantized operator patterns to the native backend in PyTorch
fold_quantized_weights: fold prepacking nodes in a quantized graph module and replace them with packed weight attributes
match_static_quantization_pattern: match the dequantize-ref-node-quantize pattern in a quantized FX graph and return matched nodes
replace_special_quantized_patterns: replace special quantized patterns like batchnorm, relu, and other fused modules with their quantized counterparts
lower_quantized_binary_operations: lower dequantize-binary-op-quantize patterns to quantized binary operations like quantized add and mul
